source_title: Nintendo Issues New Official Statement on Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Release Date - GameRant
source_excerpt:
With the launch of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 just around the corner, Nintendo has provided fans with a new way to celebrate the release. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is getting a remake as part of the franchise's 40th anniversary celebrations, so it's fitting that Nintendo would want fans to enjoy the game's launch with a formal event. As such, Zelda fans have two Nintendo-hosted in-person opportunities to experience the Ocarina of Time remake's release date with one another.
The release of the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is one of the year's most anticipated events, even competing with the hype around the launch of GTA 6 . Along with the game, Nintendo is releasing a variety of other Zelda -themed accessories for fans to collect, including a special edition Nintendo Switch 2 and Pro Controller themed around the Zelda series. Midnight launch events have fallen out of vogue with the rise of digital releases, so celebrating with other fans and scoring Zelda merch is an opportunity worth taking.
Nintendo Reveals Details on Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Midnight Release Event
Nintendo is hosting two midnight release events for Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake: one at the Nintendo store in San Francisco and one at the Nintendo store in New York City . These events will take place on Wednesday, November 4 from 9 PM to 11 PM in San Francisco, and 12 AM to 2 AM in NYC. Fans planning on attending will need to register for a Warp Pipe Pass, and the purchase of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will be limited to one per customer.
Register for a Warp Pipe Pass for the Nintendo San Francisco event
Register for a Warp Pipe Pass for the Nintendo NYC event
In addition to picking up a physical copy of the Ocarina of Time remake, Zelda fans will also have the chance to purchase some of the other special edition accessories at this launch event. Items like the Zelda 40th Anniversary Pro Controller + Stand and Carrying Case will be available while supplies last, and the special edition Zelda Nintendo Switch 2 will be in stock as well. Fans who have missed securing a pre-order for these goods online will have a second chance if they can make the event in person.

Zelda fans will also receive a free gift with purchase if they pick up the game or any of these accessories at the midnight launch event in either San Francisco or NYC. It hasn't been confirmed what this free gift will be, but pre-order bonuses from other retailers might give fans an idea of what to expect. Ocarina of Time remake pre-order bonuses range from a special holographic slip cover inspired by the N64 game's box art to replicas of Ocarina of Time 's Spiritual Stones, but none of these are available in the US, meaning attendees of this event will likely receive something exclusive.
Even if fans can attend either midnight launch event, the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will still be available to download digitally right at launch. With overhauled visuals, tweaked gameplay features, and the addition of voice acting, the Ocarina of Time remake is shaping up to be the definitive way to experience the franchise's most iconic entry.
